name: SDG
recent: SD Guthrie 宣布 2026 财年第二次中期股息每股 11.5 仙，除息日为 2027 年 1 月 13 日，派发日为 1 月 28 日。同期发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度业绩，营收环比增长 9.1%，但净利环比下降 21.7%。此外，多家机构投资者（EPF、KWAP、Amanah Saham Bumiputera）在 11 月持续申报股权变动。
notable: 宣布 2026 财年第二次中期股息每股 11.5 仙。
发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的财务报告。
多家机构投资者（EPF、KWAP、Amanah Saham Bumiputera）在 11 月多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 年第三季度营收为 MYR 53.93 亿，环比增长 9.1%，同比增长 4.3%；净利为 MYR 7.73 亿，环比下降 21.7%，同比增长 44.2%；净利率为 14.3%，低于上一季度的 20.0%。

recent_en: SD Guthrie declared a second interim dividend of 11.5 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 13 Jan 2027 and payment on 28 Jan 2027. It also released quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026, with revenue up 9.1% QoQ but net income down 21.7% QoQ. Several institutional investors (EPF, KWAP, Amanah Saham Bumiputera) continued to file changes in shareholdings in November.
notable_en: Declared a second interim dividend of 11.5 sen per share for FY2026.
Released quarterly financial results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026.
Several institutional investors (EPF, KWAP, Amanah Saham Bumiputera) filed multiple changes in shareholdings in November.
earnings_en: Q3 2026 revenue was MYR 5.393 billion, up 9.1% QoQ and 4.3% YoY; net income was MYR 773 million, down 21.7% QoQ but up 44.2% YoY; net margin was 14.3%, lower than 20.0% in the previous quarter.
